features.title: Register and sign in with email and password
features.description: Users can create an account and authenticate with a session cookie.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a user submits valid registration details, the system SHALL create an account and start a session.
WHEN a user signs in with valid credentials, the system SHALL return an authenticated session.

features.title: Create and list tasks in a workspace
features.description: Authenticated users manage tasks scoped to their workspace.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN an authenticated user creates a task, the system SHALL persist it with workspace_id scope.
WHEN an authenticated user lists tasks, the system SHALL return only tasks for their workspace.
